what: DWS maintained status — the human-knowledge layer (open threads, waiting-on-whom). The pages/sources map is auto-derived in dws_manifest.json; this file holds what a scanner can't know. Edit by hand when a thread opens/closes.
role_one_liner: design-SB is the RENDER layer: it owns the deploy repo (grammarofmeaning-site), renders every drawer/page from the other SBs' DATA exports, self-merges site PRs, and is read-only on twelve-laws.
conventions: Render-from-data, never hardcode (§2.16). A page fetches a mirrored DATA artifact; if it can't render from data yet, that's a flagged gap, not a licence to hardcode.
Mirror flow: owner-SB exports DATA on twelve-laws main → design-SB `git show origin/main:… > engine/data/X.json` → page fetches it → deploy (self-merged site PR).

schema.html is the flagship (PI author-watches it): change it only via fail-safe monkey-patches in an isolated <script> block — main script byte-identical, typeof-guards + try/catch → fall back to the prior render. Never edit the 175KB const P blob by hand.

Offline validation (no pane needed for static pages): regex-aware JS balance scan + replay the render logic against the real data in Python + curl the deployed file. Confirm zero bracket-delta vs known-good HEAD.
Pane-gated = scroll/drag/step interaction that only exists live; can't be verified offline. Build those with a live browser (mine, or the PI as eyes).

open_threads.on: design-SB (Phase 2) — gated on blessed axis→reader-words map
open_threads.detail: Content SB is SPUN UP (🐞, twelve-laws) and piloted gloss+frame_delta on MATT-28 (29 moves, one $0 SDK call). Charter v2 (CONTENT_SB_BRIEF.md) incorporates its accepted sharpenings: the Content-vs-Reading interpretive boundary and the design-crit 8-persona comprehensibility battery as VALIDATE. DELTA-OWNERSHIP FLIPPED from the charter (Content SB's better design): Content SB computes AND stores the structured axis-shift (axis/from/to) NEXT TO the prose in the move_gloss table, making the table the single store-of-record (§2.13); design-SB RENDERS the stored value and DROPS the render-side recompute (kept only as a dev cross-check). Table spec (locked with Content SB): move_gloss keyed (source_key, move_index, run_tag='gloss_s161', join-on-tag not latest-wins) + gloss + frame_delta prose + frame_delta_axis/from/to structured + gloss_model + coding_status='engine-proposed' + §2.4 provenance. RENDER MAP (REVISED after design-crit battery — 8-persona, mean 3.0/5 unanimous, on a 10-move sample). VERDICT: glosses = validated ship-as-is win (land cold, add sense beyond the paraphrase); the [axis: old→new] inline BADGE = unanimous fix target (double-says the prose shift line; surfaces raw field names like r_topology; clinical badge 'pretends to be a measurement' while the gloss is honestly a reading — §2.8). TWO-PHASE render: PHASE 1 (ship on gloss-PR land) — per move light the GLOSS line + the 'what shifted' PROSE line (the one shift representation the panel preferred); NO inline badge. PHASE 2 (follow-up) — the structured triple (axis/from/to) becomes a TRANSLATED audit-receipt ON HOVER (not inline, not double-saying), rendered ONLY from Content SB's axis→reader-words map AFTER reading-SB blesses the vocabulary (their lane; design-SB does not invent translations). Raw field names never touch the reader surface; code-names live only in the hover/legend. Phase 2 also folds majority notes: normalize arrow glyph to one Unicode →; rail-head legend defining 'move' + expanding 'WEB'. UNBLOCKED: WEB frame backfill landed (prior thread RESOLVED); Content SB populating + PRing the gloss data + triple now (seed-agnostic + idempotent upsert; filmic-metaphor steer + synthetic exemplar; grade-verb-mood ceiling so low-reliability moves hedge). PHASE 1 SHIPPED (LIVE on all 4): Content SB's move_gloss (324 rows) flows through reading-SB's view join (PR #2903) → every WEB move carries a gloss; design-SB re-mirrored + verified (gloss on EVERY move 50/55/119/100; frame_permove not regressed) + deployed. The reading rail now shows the full validated stack: verse · grammar diagram · frame ribbon · gloss line. The terse frame_delta line stays gated off (Phase-1 gate). PHASE 2 PENDING (design-SB), gated on the blessed axis→reader-words map (reading-SB owns the vocabulary; sent the map to Content SB): (1) translate the FRAME RIBBON axis labels — they still show raw names like r_topology / epistemic-warrant (pre-existing reader-surface jargon; fix #2/#3 apply to the ribbon, not just the badge); (2) add the shift as a TRANSLATED hover-receipt (structured axis/from/to → reader-words on hover, not an inline double-say); (3) normalize the arrow glyph to one Unicode →; (4) rail-head legend defining 'move' + expanding 'WEB'. All 4 Phase-2 items render from the blessed map — design-SB does not invent translations. This is the last polish before the Talmudic reading is fully reader-clean. Handovers landed: Essay SB → Content SB (twelve-laws PR #2894); reading-SB → Content SB (prose gap/silence finder + reading_room_gap_check.py gate, run pre-publish). LAST piece before the Talmudic reading is 100%.
